resources.string: Select, import or delete a GGUF model for offline translation.

Selected: %1$s\n\nDownloads are stored in the app. Importing a file makes a private copy and needs additional free space. A GGUF header alone does not guarantee compatibility. Translation is experimental.
Download %1$s directly into app storage? Internet and free space are required. The download is verified using SHA-256. Review the model license on Hugging Face.
Import and select a GGUF model in Settings first.
This language already exists. To protect existing translations, a full translation can only be saved as a new language. Choose another destination language.
No strings found for the selected source language, or no model selected.
Source language: %1$s\nChoose the language to translate INTO
%1$d strings. First 10 shown; styled strings and references remain unchanged. Review all strings after saving.
Language saved. Review the translation before building.
Nothing has been saved. Check the translation and speed before running the full translation.
Cancelling… The current model operation must finish first.
There is no translation diagnostic yet.
Diagnostics copied. It includes device details and timings, but no resource text or file paths.
Replace matching translations? Other strings in this language will be kept. Review the result before building.
Save or resolve pending target-language edits before replacing translations.
%1$d strings could not be safely translated. Existing translations are kept; new languages retain the source text. Resource names (first 20):
All strings are shown below. Tap a row to edit it before saving. Styled strings and references remain unchanged.
Not translated — tap to correct; existing target will be kept otherwise
Unchanged — tap to edit where supported
Styled strings and resource references cannot be edited here.
Keep all placeholders and use valid text.
Choose the actual language of these source strings
This target language is not supported by Google ML Kit. Choose another target language.

Translation runs on your device. Google ML Kit may download language models (about 30 MB per language) over your current connection. Translation quality can vary; check the result. Translations are provided as is and do not replace human translators. Continue?
